d: Short, honey-blonde hair with a singular curled ahoge on top and blunt-cut bangs. Bright lime-green eyes with a cheerful, wide expression on a youthful, teenage face. A slender build with a large bust, wearing a dark navy blue dress with a pleated skirt, a brown leather belt, and mismatched leg armor consisting of dark grey metallic greaves and stockings. Accessories include a small pink gemstone earring, brown fingerless gloves, and a bandage on the left thigh, while wielding a dark grey spiked mace and a circular bronze-rimmed shield.
